Implement _parse_dates(). Lowercase the message. Check patterns in this order (first match wins): 'today' -> (today, today, 'today'). 'yesterday' -> (today-1, today-1, 'yesterday'). 'this week' -> (monday of this week, today, 'this week'). 'last week' -> (monday of last week, sunday of last week, 'last week'). 'this month' -> (1st of this month, today, 'this month'). 'last month' -> (1st of last month, last day of last month, 'last month'). Use re.search(r'past (\d+) days?', msg) or r'last (\d+) days?' -> (today - N, today, f'past N days'). Use re.search(r'(\d+) days? ago', msg) -> (today - N, today - N, f'N days ago'). Check month names: re.search(r'in (january|february|march|april|may|june|july|august|september|october|november|december)', msg) -> (1st of that month this year, last day of that month, f'in Month'). If nothing matches, return (None, None, 'no date detected').
